perks.description: The Helldiver's primary weapon and sidearm both have a Laser Module. A clear laser beam indicates where the weapon will hit. It is especially useful for achieving good hits on targets.
perks.name: perk_lasersight

perks.description: A true lifesaver for the individual Helldiver. The Autoinjector increases your restoration rate and reduces the amount of effort required to get back up after being downed.
perks.name: perk_adrenaline

perks.description: The Cardio Accelerator inhibits the body's ability to become strained during long periods of exertion. With this you could run a marathon at full speed.
perks.name: perk_cardio

perks.description: A heavier armor that protects much better against small arms fire. The armor is quite heavy and will slow down your sprinting.
perks.name: perk_heavy_armor

perks.description: Exchanges the standard issue Helldiver grenades for incendiary grenades. When they explode they leave behind a fire that lasts for a short while.
perks.name: perk_grenade_incendiary

perks.description: Exchanges the standard issue Helldiver grenades for stun grenades. When they explode they stun everything in a large area. Some enemies are immune to the stunning effect such as vehicles and shielded units.
perks.name: perk_grenade_stun

perks.description: Exchanges the standard issue Helldiver grenades for smoke grenades. When they explode they disperse a large cloud of thick smoke, blocking the line of sight for all enemies.
perks.name: perk_grenade_smoke

perks.description: Lowers the cooldown of all Stratagems by 40%. A special priority requisition for the Helldiver has been made, allowing for reduced cooldown on all Stratagems used by a player.
perks.name: perk_stratagem_expert

perks.description: A field that surrounds the Helldiver and activates when the user is about to become seriously wounded. The user will automatically teleport a short distance. This was the first piece of equipment created from Illuminate research.
perks.name: perk_teleport_shield

perks.description: Tons of training has helped you throw things farther and hit things harder. Melee damage and throwing range are increased.
perks.name: perk_strong_arm

perks.description: Exchanges your standard Helldiver sidearm with a heavy revolver. The aptly nicknamed 'Gunslinger' revolver might seem flashy, but packs a proper punch and comes with built in lasersight. Part of the Pistols Pack.
perks.name: perk_revolver_sidearm

perks.description: Exchanges your standard Helldiver sidearm with a compact flamer. Though as powerful as the FLAM-40, it has shorter range and very limited ammunition. The upside is that you are always carrying a flamer for when you need to turn up the heat. Part of the Pistols Pack.
perks.name: perk_flamepistol_sidearm

perks.description: Exchanges your standard Helldiver sidearm with a Plasma pistol. Plasma weapons fire superheated gas that explodes when it hits something. This makes them less ideal for close range but very powerful against crowds. Part of the Pistols Pack.
perks.name: perk_plasmapistol_sidearm

perks.description: The Helldiver All Terrain Boots are given as special equipment to only those Helldivers that need to traverse heavy terrain on foot. They lower the slowing impact of difficult terrain. Part of the Terrain Specialist Pack.
perks.name: perk_all_terrain_boots

perks.description: Better targeting data when you are calling in Stratagems allows them to be delivered faster than if the target had to be confirmed first. Lowers Call-in time by 1 second. Part of the Precision Expert Pack.
perks.name: perk_precision_call_in

primary_weapons.description: Fully automatic assault rifle. Reliable and powerful, it's good for dealing with most threats.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_assaultrifle

primary_weapons.description: The combat rifle was created to aid Helldivers in battle when they need a higher caliber rifle. The magazine carries less rounds than the 'Liberator' assault rifle but each round is of a higher caliber, effective against medium armored targets.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_combatrifle

primary_weapons.description: A carbine version of the Liberator, it has a slightly extended magazine and much higher fire rate. Seldom used since the ammunition expenditure is far higher than any other Helldiver weapon.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_carbine

primary_weapons.description: The MG-105 is a light machinegun filling the role of fire support without being as heavy as an MG-94. Due to its lighter weight, the initial spread is quite wide, but the weapon is easily controlled once the user settles into the recoil. The MG-105 is part of the Demolitionist equipment kit.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_machinegun_light

primary_weapons.description: A reliable, low-maintenance, automatic shotgun. Perfect for quickly taking out unarmored targets and handy for close encounters.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_shotgun

primary_weapons.description: The first shotgun used by the Helldivers is still in action by certain groups of soldiers, it has a low spread that can deal massive damage to single targets. A quirk compared to other weapons is that each shell has to be loaded manually as it has an internal magazine.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_shotgunpump

primary_weapons.description: With two barrels and two triggers, this shotgun can fire both its shells at an incredible rate of fire, great for taking out large groups of enemies, or single targets at short range.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_shotgundouble

primary_weapons.description: A low caliber, rapid fire weapon that is compact and easy to handle. The Helldiver's mobility while aiming is higher when using this weapon.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_submachinegun

primary_weapons.description: With the highest rate of fire in the arsenal, this weapon is often used by the defense ministry on Super Earth for rapidly incapacitating groups of wrong-thinkers.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_machinepistol

primary_weapons.description: A silenced, compact, automatic weapon, the SMG-34 is slightly higher caliber than other weapons of similar type. It uses the same type of magazine as other SMGs, but due to the higher caliber they only hold 30 rounds. The SMG-34 is part of the Commando equipment kit.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_submachinegun_silenced

primary_weapons.description: This high caliber, semi-automatic, marksman rifle is great for taking out larger targets with a few well-placed shots. The LHO-63 is part of the Ranger equipment kit.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_marksmanrifle

primary_weapons.description: High powered weapon effective vs. armored enemies, fires super charged armor piercing ammunition.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_railgun

primary_weapons.description: The AR-14D is in reality an old assault rifle rarely seen in use amongst the armed forces. It uses the same cartridge as the AR-20L 'Justice' but in a heavier, semi-automatic, rifle. The rifle has been modernized and now fires a poison laced round causing targets hit to spasm and slow. Part of the Hazard Ops equipment kit.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_nailgun

primary_weapons.description: The M2016 'Constitution' is a reproduction of the old M1903 service rifle used in ancient times. It is fairly ineffective in combat but is used within the Super Earth Armed Forces as a ceremonial rifle. Every citizen is issued one once they turn 16 to encourage service.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_bolt_action

primary_weapons.description: This semi/full-auto rifle fires miniature, rocket-assisted, fin-stabilized, fragmentation grenades. It's great for suppressing large crowds and taking out lightly armored targets. The CR-9 is part of the Defender equipment kit.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_canisterrifle

primary_weapons.description: The PLAS-1 is the first ever Helldiver issued plasma weapon. Super Earth engineers have gone to great troubles to provide a safe and reliable weapon, and the result is a rifle firing bolts of superheated gas. The bolts explode on impact and can cause great anti-personnel damage.  Part of the Weapons Pack.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_plasmarifle

primary_weapons.description: This continuous beam weapon consumes no ammunition unless it overheats. The weapon needs to be loaded with emergency heat dump canisters to fire.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_laserrifle

primary_weapons.description: This carbine is based on laser technology but modified in an attempt to get something more similar to a conventional assault rifle. It fires short laser bursts and builds heat more quickly than the normal laser rifle. The trade off is higher burst damage but a shorter firing time. The LAS-16 is part of the Support equipment kit.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_pulselaserrifle

primary_weapons.description: This is an attempt to pack a laser into a small enough housing to be used for the same applications as conventional submachineguns. The result is a laser with a fixed focus step, allowing for high power at a very limited range. It was never widely used as the range limitation was considered too much of a drawback. The LAS-12 is part of the Specialist equipment kit.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_lasersmg

primary_weapons.description: This shotgun-like weapon is a further development on the laser carbine technology, allowing for a virtually ammunition independent weapon. Suitable for when you want an easier time hitting your target.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_lasershotgun

primary_weapons.description: The Arc Thrower projects an arc of lightning that follows the path of least resistance. The weapon can be charged up for a more powerful effect.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_arcrifle

primary_weapons.description: The AC-5 use the same charge building setup as the AC-3 but instead of discharging at a specific target, it tries to saturate an area in front of the user with electricity. This application has limited range, but the damage output is enough to completely fry light and medium targets. The AC-5 is part of the Pilot equipment kit.
primary_weapons.name: weapon_arcshotgun

sidearm_weapons.description: The P-2 pistol is your average standard issue sidearm. It fulfills the role of a last backup in case of ammunition shortage, and fills the void of a one handed weapon if the Helldiver is incapacitated or carrying important objectives.
sidearm_weapons.name: weapon_pistol

stratagems.description: Call down reinforcements to replace the Helldivers lost in action.
stratagems.name: stratagem_reinforce

stratagems.description: The Hellbomb is provided when the Helldivers need to destroy a stationary target.
stratagems.name: stratagem_hellbomb

stratagems.description: The ME-1 Metal Detector is normally used for clearing out minefields and unexploded ordnance. This version of the kit is used specifically for clearing out unexploded ordnance and is provided when required by the mission.
stratagems.name: stratagem_metaldetector

stratagems.description: An emergency beacon lands on the surface of the planet and starts to broadcast a signal to other Helldiver units. This increases the likelihood of other Helldivers joining your mission.
stratagems.name: stratagem_emergency_beacon

stratagems.description: A pod containing ammunition and ordnance. The supplies take some time to deploy as they have to be customized before being deployed.
stratagems.name: stratagem_resupply

stratagems.description: The MG-94 is a rapid fire machine gun used to achieve fire superiority. On average, it is about as powerful as an assault rifle but with a substantially larger magazine.
stratagems.name: stratagem_machinegun

stratagems.description: The MGX-42 is a magazineless, one-use, disposable machine gun designed to be discarded after having fired its ammunition. The 300 rounds of caseless ammunition are stacked in the multiple barrels and fired electronically making the weapon almost void of mechanical parts and cheap to manufacture.
stratagems.name: stratagem_machinegun_oneuse

stratagems.description: This cannon is built on upscaled, weaponized laser technology. It fires a heavy, continuous laser beam that consumes no ammunition unless it overheats. The weapon needs to be loaded with emergency heat dump canisters to fire.
stratagems.name: stratagem_lasercannon

stratagems.description: The AC-22 Autocannon is a staple of Helldiver weaponry. Usually reserved for APCs and other vehicles, this is a shoulder carried version for the Helldiver on foot. It is an extremely bulky weapon, but performs very well against medium-heavy armored targets. Part of the Weapons Pack.
stratagems.name: stratagem_20mm_cannon

stratagems.description: The indirect fire grenade launcher fires impact-detonated rifle grenades at a high rate of fire. Is especially useful in tight spaces where there is a need to fire above teammates.
stratagems.name: stratagem_grenadelauncher

stratagems.description: The 'Rumbler' portable mortar is a heavy piece of equipment and very clunky in its operation. Its clunkiness is tolerated however, mostly because of its immense firepower, but also because it is a variable distance indirect fire weapon. Part of the Weapons Pack.
stratagems.name: stratagem_mortar

stratagems.description: A compact flamethrower capable of projecting Napalm flames several meters. Enemies hit with this weapon will start to burn and it will leave swaths of fire in its wake.
stratagems.name: stratagem_flamethrower

stratagems.description: A design very similar to the standard issue flamethrower, this high pressure weapon dispenses a toxic sludge. The toxin causes heavy trauma to the nervous system and slows down afflicted individuals as well as causing brain damage. It was developed by Dr. Junko under the 2079 act of self defense research and has been tested extensively on live targets. The TOX-13 is part of the Hazard Ops equipment kit.
stratagems.name: stratagem_chemthrower

stratagems.description: A powerful multi-purpose recoilless rifle for taking out larger targets. The RL-112 is delivered with a backpack containing additional ammunition.
stratagems.name: stratagem_recoilless

stratagems.description: Calls down two EAT-17 Expendable Anti Tank weapons. The EAT is a one-use rocket capable of damaging heavily armored targets.
stratagems.name: stratagem_law

stratagems.description: The 4X Missile Launcher System is a shoulder carried, multiple missile system. It launches four heat seeking missiles that try to home in on targets and eliminate them. The MLS-4X is part of the Commando equipment kit.
stratagems.name: stratagem_missile_launcher

stratagems.description: The AD-334 'Guard Dog' is a defensive automated drone armed with a small submachine gun. It is based from a backpack carried on the Helldivers back and will land there to rearm whenever it runs out of ammunition or when there is a break in the action. The AD-334 is part of the Defender equipment kit.
stratagems.name: stratagem_drone_defensive_backpack

stratagems.description: The AD-289 'Angel' is a support drone capable of healing injured Helldivers that are nearby. It has limited supply of the regenerative substance and will land in the backpack to refill when it runs out or when there is a break in the action. The AD-289 is part of the Support equipment kit.
stratagems.name: stratagem_drone_heal_backpack

stratagems.description: A backpack capable of carrying 2 crates of ammunition which both you and other Helldivers can resupply from. Ammunition that is picked up will automatically be added to the Resupply Pack.
stratagems.name: stratagem_ammo_backpack

stratagems.description: The Helldiver-issued jump pack propels the wearer a short distance into the air and forward allowing for swift movement over difficult terrain. The pack is cumbersome, and as a result, the wearer won't be able to go prone.
stratagems.name: stratagem_jumppack

stratagems.description: A shield pack that projects a kinetically slowing shield in front of the user. The Shield slows down projectiles and attacks, allowing Helldivers to take far more fire before having to get out of the way. Due to technical limitations, the shield covers only the front of the Helldiver. Part of the Entrenched Pack.
stratagems.name: stratagem_projected_shield

stratagems.description: The shield pack provides the wearer with a powerful shield essentially extending the amount of damage the Helldiver can take before dying.
stratagems.name: stratagem_shield_generator_pack

stratagems.description: This is a very versatile repair tool capable of repairing damaged vehicles as well as mending flesh. Helldivers proficient with the REP-80 are much loved by their comrades; no one enjoys to die.
stratagems.name: stratagem_repairtool

stratagems.description: The REC-6 Satchel Charge is an explosive charge with a handle, capable of being remotely detonated using the reload action at the time of the wielder's choosing. The explosion is powerful enough to take out objectives and most heavily armored enemies. The REC-6 is part of the Demolitionist equipment kit.
stratagems.name: stratagem_satchelcharge

stratagems.description: The pinnacle of Helldiver weaponry; the EXO-44 is a manned walker armed with the MG-11 minigun and eight anti-infantry homing missiles.
stratagems.name: stratagem_exosuit

stratagems.description: The Obsidian exosuit is a continued and specialized development of the EXO-44. Armed with two twin 20mm autocannons, it is devastating to low and medium armored targets. Its only drawback is the distinct lack of Anti-Tank capability. The EXO-48 is part of the Pilot equipment kit.
stratagems.name: stratagem_exosuit_2

stratagems.description: The EXO-51 was developed as a specific counter to heavier enemy targets, incorporating a 90mm cannon into the design. It is also armed with a flamer to deal with smaller threats. Some compromises were made to accommodate the large cannon, most notably it has severely limited ammunition and lacks gyro stabilization for its main gun. Part of the Vehicles Pack.
stratagems.name: stratagem_exosuit_3

stratagems.description: A sturdy combat motorcycle complete with sidecar. This vehicle is excellent for Helldiver units that want to get around fast. Though lightly armored, it has superior speed and agility compared to the vehicles usually found in the Helldiver arsenal. Part of the Vehicles Pack.
stratagems.name: stratagem_bike

stratagems.description: A small fairly mobile tankdestroyer. Prized for its incredibly powerful main gun and large ammunition stores, this beast is a beautiful piece of machinery. Requiring two people to operate, a driver and a gunner, both members have to work together to get the most out of the 'Bastion'. Part of the Vehicles Pack.
stratagems.name: stratagem_tankdestroyer

stratagems.description: The M5 is a 4-seat armored personnel carrier equipped with a double barrel light auto-cannon and two smaller support weapons. It traverses snow and shallow water with ease.
stratagems.name: stratagem_apc

stratagems.description: Built on the M5 APC chassis, this Heavy Assault Vehicle still houses 4 Helldivers but is more heavily armed. Sporting a 90mm main cannon and two smaller support weapons, it is far better equipped to face more heavily armored enemies.
stratagems.name: stratagem_apc_cannon

stratagems.description: The 'Humblebee' UAV drone provides the Helldivers with eyes in the sky, increasing the area where it is possible to detect patrols. The UAV will follow the Helldivers until it runs out of fuel and has to leave the area. The UAV drone is part of the Ranger equipment kit.
stratagems.name: stratagem_uav_drone

stratagems.description: Sends powerful shockwaves into the ground attracting patrols several hundred meters away. This piece of equipment is to be used as a diversion.
stratagems.name: stratagem_distractor

stratagems.description: A well armored anti tank emplacement that has to be operated manually. Early versions had the same automated AI as the current generation turrets, but it was deemed too volatile. Very good at destroying heavily armored enemies. Part of the Entrenched Pack.
stratagems.name: stratagem_mannable_turret

stratagems.description: Call in an automatic minigun turret to give you a bit of extra firepower or to act as a sentry for a specific area. The turret is capable of distinguishing friend from foe but be careful not to get in its way.
stratagems.name: stratagem_turret

stratagems.description: Call in an automatic railcannon turret to help you out. The turret is capable of distinguishing friend from foe, but be careful with its unstoppable rounds.
stratagems.name: stratagem_turret_railcannon

stratagems.description: The A/GL-8 Launcher Turret is the latest development in automated sentry technology. Launching the same rounds as the Obliterator, it has immense firepower and shoots over obstacles. Meant for fixed position defense, a variable firing range was not deemed necessary during development. The turret can discern friend from foe, but watch out for the blast radius.
stratagems.name: stratagem_turret_grenadelauncher

stratagems.description: A powerful tower that builds an electric charge when a target comes close and unloads a powerful lightning strike onto it after a short while. The automated tower is NOT capable of discerning friend from foe.
stratagems.name: stratagem_tesla_tower

stratagems.description: Calls in a carpet of self-arming, self-burying, anti-personnel mines. Anything that walks over them will set them off and the mine explodes after a short while.
stratagems.name: stratagem_minedrop

stratagems.description: A single round of smoke is fired from a nearby 'Thunderer' artillery emplacement. The smoke will cover a small area for a short while and block all line of sight.
stratagems.name: stratagem_artillery_smoke

stratagems.description: A barbwire barrier delivered via airdrop. The barrier is very effective at slowing down incoming enemies and is a semi-permanent solution great for when you need to hold ground for longer periods.  Part of the Entrenched Pack.
stratagems.name: stratagem_barricade

stratagems.description: Call in a carpet of self-arming, self-burying stun mines. Anything that walks over them will set them off, and when a mine explodes it stuns everything in a small area. Some enemies are immune to the stunning effect, such as vehicles and shielded units.
stratagems.name: stratagem_minedrop_stun

stratagems.description: The immediate area is covered in Static Field Conductors that shock nearby enemies, slowing their movement considerably.
stratagems.name: stratagem_staticfield

stratagems.description: A fighter in orbit diverts to your location and delivers a high speed airstrike on the beacon. The Airstrike will always be perpendicular to the throwing direction.
stratagems.name: stratagem_airstrike

stratagems.description: A plane swoops by and delivers a single laser guided bomb. The bomb is not very powerful and useless versus armor, but makes up for its lack of power in precision.
stratagems.name: stratagem_dive_bomb

stratagems.description: A fighter equipped with two heavy machine guns strafes the target area, causing massive anti-personnel damage.
stratagems.name: stratagem_strafingrun

stratagems.description: Close air support lays down a carpet of incendiary bombs, creating a flaming area that sets targets on fire and causes damage over time.
stratagems.name: stratagem_napalmstrike

stratagems.description: An Eagle fighter jet armed with a 25mm chain gun strafes the area. The heavy rounds explode on impact, making it far more potent than the regular Strafing Run. This comes with the trade off of a longer time between engagements as the fighter has to swing wide and accelerate to compensate for recoil.
stratagems.name: stratagem_strafingrun_heavy

stratagems.description: A low flying run from an 'Eagle', where it strafes the area with its main cannon and fires two missiles that home in on targets. It has both great anti-tank and anti-personnel applications and represents the versatility of Helldivers air power. The Close Air Support Stratagem is part of the Specialist equipment kit.
stratagems.name: stratagem_close_air_support

stratagems.description: A portable missile battery fires a salvo at the targeted location, pretty much obliterating anything in the targeted area. The missile battery takes a substantial amount of time to reload, but its destructive capability is matched only by the 'Shredder'. Part of the Terrain Specialist Pack.
stratagems.name: stratagem_missile_barrage

stratagems.description: A continuous barrage from nearby 'Thunderer' artillery is called in on the target area. Anything in the target area stands a high risk of sustaining injuries and/or death from the powerful 130mm shells. Lasts for 3 salvoes.
stratagems.name: stratagem_artillery

stratagems.description: An artillery strike fired in a tight cluster with top modern homing rounds able to alter their trajectory. The strike will target the largest enemy in range and make sure to land on it if possible. Part of the Precision Expert Pack.
stratagems.name: stratagem_precision_artillery

stratagems.description: An orbital laser strikes from the skies and tracks targets on the ground. The beam does massive damage against soft targets but is unable to damage heavily armored targets.
stratagems.name: stratagem_orbital_strike

stratagems.description: A Tracking Micro-Nuclear Tactical missile is called in, striking as close as possible to the beacon. Side effects include shell shock, mutation, and/or death. It's nicknamed "The Shredder" by the Helldivers.
stratagems.name: stratagem_missile_strike

stratagems.description: A ship in orbit picks the largest target in very close proximity to the beacon and fires a high velocity railcannon round at the target's predicted position.
stratagems.name: stratagem_railcannon_strike
